items.summary:
Background
Gout is the most common form of inflammatory arthritis, affecting 41 million adults worldwide. The global burden of gout has been increasing over the last three decades, yet its management remains suboptimal. The primary aim of this manuscript is to review the impact of various diets such as the DASH, Mediterranean, and low purine diets; weight loss; and individual foods, including alcohol, caffeine, cherry, dairy, high-fructose corn syrup, omega-3 fatty acids, and vitamin C on hyperuricemia and clinical gout outcomes such as flares and tophi.Conclusion
Few studies to date have specifically evaluated the effect of various dietary approaches on hyperuricemia among people with gout and on gout-specific outcomes. Although gout's cardinal feature is inflammatory arthritis, it is closely associated with insulin resistance and considered a manifestation of the metabolic syndrome. As such, both gout and hyperuricemia are often associated with major cardiometabolic and renal comorbidities that drive the persistently elevated premature mortality rates among gout patients. items.title: Diet After Cholecystectomy
items.title_orig: Diet After Cholecystectomy
items.summary: Patients with gallstones are often affected by alimentary disorders contributing to the onset of gallstones disease. Cholecystectomy can have nutritional and metabolic consequences in the short-term (diarrhea, abdominal pain and bloating) and in the long-term (increased Body Mass Index with metabolic syndrome, gastritis, liposoluble vitamin deficiency). Pathogenic mechanisms behind these disturbances are reviewed and the need for an early post-operative nutritional intervention based on low-lipid, high-fibers diet, is highlighted.

items.summary: Plant-based diets (PBDs) are associated with decreased risk of morbidity and mortality associated with important noncommunicable chronic diseases. Similar to animal-based food sources (e.g., meat, fish, and animal visceral organs), some plant-based food sources (e.g., certain soy legume products, sea vegetables, and brassica vegetables) also contain a high purine load. Suboptimally designed PBDs might consequently be associated with increased uric acid levels and gout development. items.summary: Gout is well known as an inflammatory rheumatic disease presenting with arthritis and abnormal metabolism of uric acid. The recognition of diet-induced systemic metabolic pathways have provided new mechanistic insights and potential interventions on gout progression. However, the dietary recommendations for gouty patients generally focus on food categories, with few simultaneous considerations of nutritional factors and systemic metabolism. It is worthwhile to comprehensively review the mechanistic findings and potential interventions of diet-related nutrients against the development of gout, including purine metabolism, urate deposition, and gouty inflammation. items.title_orig: Recent advances in fructose intake and risk of hyperuricemia
items.summary: With the widespread popularity of hyperuricemia, it has become a severe threat to human public health. Accumulating evidence suggests that dietary fructose has a close relationship with hyperuricemia, but the role of fructose intake in hyperuricemia remains unclear. Hyperuricemia is characterized by excessive production and deposition of urate crystals. Metabolism of fructose leads to the increased serum concentration of urate. In this review, we depict an update of fructose consumption worldwide and the epidemiology of hyperuricemia and summarize the progress in studying the relationship between fructose intake and the risk of hyperuricemia. This review highlights the metabolic process of fructose in the liver, small intestine, and kidney. Obesity can lead to ectopic pancreatic fat accumulation and increase the risk for type 2 diabetes. Smaller intervention trials have shown a decrease in pancreatic fat content (PFC) with weight loss, and we intended to investigate the effects of weight loss on PFC in a larger trial.Methods

items.summary: Post-cholecystectomy non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), now encompassed within metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), is increasingly linked to persistent disruption of bile acid kinetics and gut-liver axis signaling after gallbladder removal. items.summary:
Aim
The "2026 ACC/AHA/AACVPR/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Dyslipidemia" retires and replaces the "2018 AHA/ACC/AACVPR/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol."Methods
A comprehensive literature search was conducted from October 2024 to December 2024 to identify clinical studies, systematic reviews and meta-analyses, and other evidence conducted on human participants that were published in English from MEDLINE (through PubMed), EMBASE, the Cochrane Library, Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality, and other selected databases relevant to this guideline.Structure
The focus of this clinical practice guideline is to address the evaluation, management, and monitoring of individuals with dyslipidemias, including high blood cholesterol, hypertriglyceridemia, and elevated lipoprotein(a).

items.summary: Intrapancreatic fat deposition (IPFD) has garnered increasing attention in recent years. The prevalence of IPFD is relatively high and associated with factors such as obesity, age, and sex. However, the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying IPFD remain unclear, with several potential contributing factors, including oxidative stress, alterations in the gut microbiota, and hormonal imbalances. IPFD was found to be highly correlated with the occurrence and prognosis of exocrine pancreatic diseases. The National Lipid Association previously published recommendations for lifestyle therapies to manage dyslipidemia. items.title_orig: Cholecystectomy promotes the development of colorectal cancer by the alternation of bile acid metabolism and the gut microbiota
items.summary: The incidence and mortality of colorectal cancer (CRC) have been markedly increasing worldwide, causing a tremendous burden to the healthcare system. Therefore, it is crucial to investigate the risk factors and pathogenesis of CRC. Cholecystectomy is a gold standard procedure for treating symptomatic cholelithiasis and gallstone diseases. The rhythm of bile acids entering the intestine is altered after cholecystectomy, which leads to metabolic disorders. Nonetheless, emerging evidence suggests that cholecystectomy might be associated with the development of CRC. It has been reported that alterations in bile acid metabolism and gut microbiota are the two main reasons. However, the potential mechanisms still need to be elucidated. items.title: Cholecystectomy as a risk factor for metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease: unveiling the metabolic and chronobiologic clues behind the bile acid enterohepatic circulation
items.title_orig: Cholecystectomy as a risk factor for metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease: unveiling the metabolic and chronobiologic clues behind the bile acid enterohepatic circulation
items.summary: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) is highly prevalent worldwide. Recent clinical and experimental studies have addressed the association between cholecystectomy and MAFLD, confirming that cholecystectomy is an independent risk factor for MAFLD. In this review, we describe the epidemiologic evidence that links cholecystectomy to MAFLD, and discuss the possible mechanisms behind these connections, in order to unveil the metabolic and chronobiologic signals conveyed by the waves of the bile acid enterohepatic circulation.

topics.name: 胆囊术后
topics.short: 胆囊切除后的消化适应

topics.name: 高血脂
topics.short: 血脂管理与心血管风险

topics.name: 胰腺脂肪浸润
topics.short: 胰脂肪沉积与胰腺功能保护

gallstone.headline: 切除胆囊不是「不能吃油」，而是「不能一次吃太多油」。
gallstone.intro: 胆囊的作用是储存和浓缩胆汁。切除后胆汁改为持续少量流入肠道，遇到一顿高脂大餐时没有足够的胆汁「突击」支援，未消化的脂肪进入结肠，就会出现腹胀、腹泻、油花样大便。绝大多数人在 3–6 个月内通过肠道适应自然缓解。

diet.d: 脂肪供能比控制在 20–25%，优先植物油、深海鱼、坚果等不饱和来源；避免油炸、肥肉、奶油点心、动物皮。

diet.t: 少量多餐优于一日三大餐
diet.d: 把一天的脂肪总量分散到 4–5 餐，单餐脂肪越少，胆汁供需越容易匹配。
适应期后逐步恢复常规饮食。长期过度限脂反而可能影响脂溶性维生素（A、D、E、K）吸收。
可溶性纤维（燕麦、豆类、苹果、魔芋）能结合胆汁酸、改善腹泻，并降低胆汁酸在肠道的过度刺激。
坚果酱、沙拉酱、酥皮点心、奶茶、火锅蘸料，往往比一块瘦肉更容易触发症状。
两者都会加重胆汁成分异常与肝脏脂质负担，是胆总管结石复发的可干预因素。

life.t: 稳步减重，避免快速减重
life.d: 每周减重超过 1.5 kg 会增加胆汁胆固醇饱和度，是结石形成的经典诱因。目标为每周 0.5–1 kg。

life.t: 规律进食，不长时间空腹
life.d: 空腹时间过长会使胆汁淤积、胆囊（或胆管）内压力升高。
促进胃肠蠕动与胆汁排空，对腹胀和胆汁反流有实际帮助。

watch.t: 右上腹持续疼痛、发热、黄疸
watch.d: 三者同时出现提示胆管梗阻或胆管炎，需立即就医，不能观察等待。

watch.t: 持续水样腹泻超过 3 个月
watch.d: 可能是胆汁酸性腹泻，属于可治疗的问题，医生可用胆汁酸结合剂，不必硬扛。

watch.t: 油腻餐后反复右肩背放射痛
watch.d: 需排查胆总管残余结石或乳头功能障碍。

myths.q: 切了胆囊就不能吃鸡蛋？
myths.a: 可以吃。蛋黄确实含脂肪，但同时富含卵磷脂与优质蛋白。关键是不要一次吃多个油炸蛋，水煮蛋通常耐受良好。

myths.q: 切了胆囊就不会再长结石？
myths.a: 不对。结石仍可能在胆总管内形成，发生率约 5–15%，所以长期饮食管理依然有意义。

lipid.headline: 降 LDL 靠「换油」和「加纤维」，降甘油三酯靠「减糖」和「戒酒」——这是两条不同的路径。
lipid.intro: 血脂不是单一指标。低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）主要由饱和脂肪摄入和遗传决定，是动脉粥样硬化的直接推手；甘油三酯（TG）则高度受精制碳水、果糖和酒精影响。弄混这两条路径，是很多人「吃得很清淡但指标不降」的原因。

diet.t: 把饱和脂肪压到总能量 7% 以下
diet.d: 具体做法：换掉肥肉、猪油、黄油、椰子油、全脂奶制品，改吃菜籽油、橄榄油、亚麻籽油。

diet.t: 可溶性纤维每天 10 g 以上
diet.d: 约等于 60 g 燕麦 + 一份豆类。β-葡聚糖和果胶能结合胆汁酸、促进 LDL 清除，LDL 可降 5–10%。
可再降 LDL 约 8–10%。强化植物甾醇的食用油或酸奶是现实来源。
三文鱼、鲭鱼、沙丁鱼提供 EPA/DHA，主要降低甘油三酯，对 TG 偏高者收益更明显。

diet.t: 严格限制添加糖与果糖
diet.d: 含糖饮料、果汁、蜂蜜、糕点中的果糖在肝脏直接转化为 TG。这一条对甘油三酯的影响大于对胆固醇的影响。

diet.t: 酒精是甘油三酯的强升因素
diet.d: TG 偏高者建议完全戒酒；即使少量饮酒也可能使 TG 上升 20–30%。

diet.t: 用坚果替代零食，而不是额外加餐
diet.d: 每天 20–30 g 原味坚果有益，但热量密度高，需等量替换而非叠加。

life.t: 每周 150 分钟中等强度有氧 + 2 次抗阻
life.d: 运动主要提升 HDL、降低 TG，对 LDL 影响有限——这也说明为什么「光靠运动」降不了 LDL。
对 TG 和 HDL 改善最明显，对 LDL 的降幅通常只有 3–5%。
吸烟降低 HDL 并加速 LDL 氧化，是独立于血脂数值的风险因素。

watch.d: 急性胰腺炎风险显著升高，需尽快就医，不能只靠饮食调整。

watch.t: 服药后出现肌肉酸痛、乏力
watch.d: 需查肌酸激酶，排除他汀相关肌病，不要自行停药或硬扛。

watch.t: 调脂治疗 4–12 周需复查
watch.d: 复查血脂 + 肝功能，评估疗效与耐受性，再决定是否调整方案。

myths.a: 不一定。精制碳水、油炸素食、椰子油制品同样会推高 TG 和 LDL。关键在脂肪类型与碳水质量，而非「有没有肉」。

myths.q: 胆固醇吃多了才血脂高？
myths.a: 膳食胆固醇的影响远小于饱和脂肪与遗传。多数人每天 1 个鸡蛋无碍，真正要盯的是饱和脂肪和总能量。

uric.headline: 升尿酸最猛的不是海鲜，是含糖饮料和酒。
uric.intro: 尿酸是嘌呤代谢的终产物。约 2/3 来自体内自身合成，1/3 来自食物。果糖在肝脏代谢时会消耗 ATP、加速嘌呤分解，同时竞争性抑制尿酸排泄——这是含糖饮料比多数海鲜更能推高尿酸的原因。

diet.t: 严格限制高嘌呤动物性食物
diet.d: 动物内脏、浓肉汤/火锅老汤、沙丁鱼、凤尾鱼、贝类。红肉每日不超过 100 g。
包括「鲜榨」果汁和蜂蜜水。果糖的双重机制（生成增加 + 排泄减少）使其成为最强饮食因素之一。
啤酒既含嘌呤又含酒精，是痛风发作的经典诱因；发作期应完全避免。
心、肾功能正常者适用。分次饮用，尿液保持清淡色，有助于尿酸排出与预防尿酸结石。

diet.t: 低脂乳制品有保护作用
diet.d: 牛奶、无糖酸奶可促进尿酸排泄，是少数「可主动增加」的食物类别。
这是过时观念。植物嘌呤对血尿酸影响远小于动物嘌呤，豆腐、豆浆可适量食用。

diet.t: 蔬菜、樱桃、咖啡可正常吃
diet.d: 蔬菜总体不升尿酸；樱桃与咖啡有弱的降尿酸证据，属「有益无害」，但不足以替代治疗。

life.d: 一次性高强度运动使 ATP 大量分解、乳酸堆积抑制尿酸排泄，是常见的发作诱因。中等强度有氧更安全。
温度下降使尿酸盐更易析出结晶，夜间足部保暖有实际意义。

life.t: 减重但避免饥饿式减重
life.d: 快速减重与生酮饮食会升高血尿酸，需平稳推进。

watch.t: 急性发作期不加用降尿酸药
watch.d: 通常待急性期缓解 2–4 周后再启动，否则血尿酸波动可能加重发作。具体时机由医生决定。
有痛风石者需 < 300 μmol/L。达标后仍需维持，不可自行停药。
需与化脓性关节炎、蜂窝织炎鉴别，不能一律按痛风处理。

myths.q: 不吃海鲜内脏，尿酸就能正常？
myths.a: 多数人不行。内源性合成占 2/3，饮食干预通常只能降 60–90 μmol/L。是否用药取决于基线水平和是否有痛风/结石。

myths.q: 痛风不痛了就可以停药？
myths.a: 不对。疼痛消失只代表炎症消退，尿酸盐结晶仍在沉积。擅自停药是复发和痛风石形成的主因。

pancreas.headline: 胰腺脂肪浸润是可逆的——减重是目前证据最强的干预。
pancreas.intro: 胰腺脂肪浸润（脂肪胰）指脂肪在胰腺实质内异常沉积，常与肥胖、内脏脂肪堆积、高甘油三酯、酒精摄入并存。它本身多无症状，但长期可影响胰腺外分泌功能（消化吸收）与内分泌功能（血糖调节），也是胰腺炎风险的背景因素。好消息是：随着体重和甘油三酯下降，影像上的脂肪沉积可以明显减少。

diet.d: 减重 5–10% 即可显著降低胰腺脂肪含量。这是目前所有干预中证据最一致的。
酒精对胰腺腺泡细胞有直接毒性，且与脂肪浸润协同损伤，是胰腺炎最强的可控危险因素。

diet.t: 把甘油三酯压到 2.3 mmol/L 以下
diet.d: TG > 5.6 mmol/L 时急性胰腺炎风险陡增。控糖、戒酒、减重、必要时用药，缺一不可。
一次大量脂肪会刺激胆囊收缩素大量释放、胰酶分泌骤增，对已有脂肪浸润的胰腺是额外负荷。

diet.t: 脂肪泻时考虑中链甘油三酯（MCT）
diet.d: MCT 不需要脂肪酶和胆盐参与即可吸收，可作为部分脂肪替代。需在医生或营养师指导下使用。
若存在胰腺外分泌功能不全，维生素 A、D、E、K 吸收会受影响，必要时检测并补充。

life.d: 抗阻训练增加骨骼肌量、改善胰岛素敏感性，对减少异位脂肪沉积有独立价值。

life.t: 控制血糖与胰岛素抵抗
life.d: 胰岛素抵抗是脂肪异位沉积的重要机制，控糖本身就是护胰。
腹部超声敏感度有限，MRI-PDFF 或超声内镜（EUS）更能定量评估脂肪含量，随访方案由医生制定。

watch.t: 脂肪泻、体重下降、饭后腹胀
watch.d: 提示胰腺外分泌功能不全，需检测粪弹性蛋白酶，可能需要胰酶替代治疗。

watch.t: 持续上腹痛并向背部放射
watch.d: 警惕慢性胰腺炎或急性发作，需及时就诊。

watch.t: 新发血糖升高或难以控制
watch.d: 胰腺内分泌功能受损的表现，需评估是否为胰源性糖尿病（3c 型）。

myths.q: 脂肪胰只是「影像上的小问题」？
myths.a: 不是。它与代谢综合征、胰腺外分泌功能不全、胰腺炎风险相关，且是可干预的，值得认真对待。
不准确。关键在总能量与体重、酒精、甘油三酯。单纯把油减到极低而不减重，脂肪浸润不会明显改善。

disclaimer: 以上内容整理自公开的临床指南与共识（如《中国血脂管理指南》《中国高尿酸血症与痛风诊疗指南》、AGA/ESGE 相关综述等），仅作健康科普与生活方式参考，不构成诊断或处方建议。个体情况（尤其合并用药、肝肾功能、术后并发症）差异较大，具体方案请由你的主诊医生确定。
